chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi narrated to us, he said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ali al-Alawi al-Zaydi narrated to us, he said: al-Ridha Ali ibn Musa, peace be upon them both, narrated to us, he said: My father, the righteous servant, Musa ibn Ja'far, narrated to me, he said: My father, al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, narrated to me, he said: My father, al-Baqir Muhammad ibn Ali, narrated to me, he said: My father, Zayn al-Abidin Ali ibn al-Husayn, narrated to me, he said: My father, al-Husayn ibn Ali, the martyr, narrated to me, he said: My father, the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, narrated to me, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, said:
Whoever performs an obligatory prayer, he has before God a supplication that will be answered.

key_terms.دَعْوَة مُسْتَجَابَة: Da'wa mustajaba -- an answered supplication; a prayer to God that is guaranteed to be fulfilled
key_terms.سِلْسِلَة الذَّهَب: Silsilat al-dhahab -- the golden chain; a chain of narration in which every link is one of the twelve Shia Imams, considered the most reliable isnad
key_terms.فَرِيضَة: Farida -- an obligatory prayer; one of the five daily ritual prayers (salat) that are mandatory upon every Muslim

ai.seo_question: What reward does the Prophet promise for performing obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches, through the celebrated golden chain of narration (silsilat al-dhahab) passing through all twelve Imams, that whoever performs an obligatory prayer earns a supplication that God is certain to answer. This concise prophetic tradition was transmitted in Shaykh al-Mufid's teaching circle in Baghdad during the early 5th century AH. Its chain of narration is among the most revered in Shia hadith literature, as each link is an infallible Imam narrating from his father, connecting the faithful directly to the Prophet's own words.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn ‘Ali al-Alawi al-Zaidi, who reported from al-Ridha, ‘Ali ibn Musa, peace be upon him that: The righteous slave of Allah, my father, Musa ibn Ja’far reported from his father al-Sadiq, Ja’far ibn Muhammad, reported from his father Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir, reported from his father, Zainul Abedeen ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, reported from his father, al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali al-Shaheed, reported from his father Amirul Mu’mineen ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "
He who performs his (daily) obligatory prayer, earns a blessing of (at least) one supplication answered by Allah."
